items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mack the Knife was with André Previn, wasn’t it?

ctx.x: Then you revisited the one where you did Mack the Knife in the two keys.
Oh yeah. Wait a minute. Mack the Knife was with André Previn, wasn’t it?
Yes. That was the two trombones, wasn’t it?
